description:
Extends the independent validator of the offline tuning campaign so it accepts a published stage whose measured owner is `gf2-coding`.

## Background

The offline tuning system calibrates selectors through an owner producer, `crates/<owner>/benches/tuning_calibration.rs`, run by `dev/scripts/tuning-extent-campaign.sh` from a committed campaign declaration: the neutral driver stages and journals the campaign, the composer writes a versioned owner envelope whose measurement block carries the producer's behaviour token and executable digest, and an independent validator accepts the published stage. `gf2-core` and `gf2-algebra` are owners; `gf2-coding` has an owner codec and no producer. The validator `dev/scripts/validate-tuning-extent-campaign.py` re-derives a published campaign stage independently of the driver and names the two owners, their protocols, behaviour tokens and section identities in closed tables. The driver and the composer handle a campaign that measures the coding owner and imports the core and algebra envelopes.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The validator accepts a published stage that measures `gf2-coding` and imports `gf2-core` and `gf2-algebra`: owner manifest, declared counts, raw result index, owner decisions, composition and publication paths.
- [hard] REQ-02: It rejects a coding stage whose behaviour token, section identity or declared counts differ from the declaration.
- [hard] REQ-03: Each committed campaign publication of the two earlier owners validates with the verdict it had before.
- [hard] REQ-04: The validator's self-tests cover the coding owner.
title: Accept a coding owner campaign in the tuning campaign validator
